column6: Vtable slot 4. Allocates 0x68 bytes through the host (tag "X"), constructs a GeomGroup, asserts not NULL (line 136), CopyFrom(this, scale), returns it. GeomCone's slot 4 (0x802E2604) is the same pattern for a cone
